dict.string: Personal Tracker uses your location to track and visualize the places you visit. This data stays on your device and is never shared without your permission.
Personal Tracker can track your location in the background to provide a complete picture of your daily activities. All location data is encrypted and stored locally on your device.
Personal Tracker accesses your calendar to help you understand how you spend your time. Your calendar data is processed locally and never leaves your device without your explicit consent.
Personal Tracker can track your reminders to give you insights into your tasks and productivity. All data is stored securely on your device.
Personal Tracker accesses your photo library to track your media creation habits. Your photos and videos are analyzed locally and metadata is stored securely.
Personal Tracker accesses your contacts to enrich call and communication data (optional). Contact information is processed locally and never uploaded.
Personal Tracker may use the camera to capture moments and create visual records (optional feature).
Personal Tracker may use the microphone for voice notes and annotations (optional feature).
